methods.apiCredentials: Sent only to the respective API origin. Never sent to image CDNs.
methods.bodyRetention: Only selected public fields, counts and request outcomes are saved. Raw source bodies and credential values are not included.

icons.countCaveat: Reported total is not a distinct-file count for this sample. It equals 3 PNG assets plus 9 and 4 ICO directory entries; the upstream counting implementation was not inspected.

schemaDifferences: The current search response contains game records directly in data; the OpenAPI example/schema nests the response envelope in each array item.
Actual game/artwork responses include useful fields absent from the inspected schema, including release_date, image dimensions, mime, language and flags.
ICO resources report source width/height as zero; directory entries contain positive dimensions.

fanart.credentialModeTested: client-key only; no project api-key header was sent

aimer.name: Aimer
aimer.typeEvidenceRole: Research fixture only; not an added runtime MusicBrainz provider or lookup dependency.

limitations: No name-search method was found in the current official API/client surface.
Season labels include concrete numbers, all, and missing values; show-wide images do not prove a native season match.
The artist response does not classify Person versus Group.
image_count can include album artwork and is not the candidate count for a native person field.
Freshness tiers are documented, but project-key-only comparison and exact delay boundaries were not tested.

observedRestrictions: Grid requests are restricted to the existing configured 600x900 cover dimensions.
Artwork reads make one listing request without subsequent pages.
Name resolution selects a year match or the first search result.
steamgriddb.scope: Read-only source inspection. These observations are not accepted rules for the replacement design, and no running extension settings were changed.

remainingVerification: Fanart project-key and combined-key access, and documented freshness boundaries.
SteamGridDB platform bridges other than the Steam mapping already exercised.
Complete extension execution, ICO conversion, image-only preview and final attachment adoption.
